extern int scanf (const char *, ...);
extern void *memset (void *, int, __SIZE_TYPE__);

int
foo (void)
{
  char buf[128];

#if USE_SCANF
  if (scanf("%s", buf) != 1)
    return 42;
#endif

  memset (buf,0, sizeof (buf));
  asm volatile("": : :"memory");
  return 0;
}
